Token burn means consumption volume, not merely AI proficiency, adoption or useful results.
The production assertion includes work subsequently reviewed or repaired by engineers, because the context explicitly allows that route.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Adequately scoped policy and implementation records establish that the asserted requirements or token-based incentives did not apply, or that the described contributions did not reach production. Missing public policies alone do not contradict the claim.
